(3 Positions)
Target Business Services
Location: 61 Clifford Street, Maddington WA 6109 
Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation
 
Our client Convenience Marketing Solutions Pty Ltd trading as Shikha Transport has been at the forefront of Western Australia’s heavy transport sector — has a story of growth, innovation and an unwavering commitment to clients’ success. The  vision is to be the most trusted and efficient bulk-haulage partner for the resources and agricultural sectors in WA, delivering every load safely, on time, and with the utmost professionalism. 

Shikha Transport operates a modern fleet including quad and super-quad trailer combinations to optimise payload and reduce vehicle movements. The services cover large-scale movement of iron ore, nickel, grain, sand and other essential raw materials, shuttle runs from mine sites to processing plants and ports, and timely agricultural haulage during peak harvest seasons. We provide integrated, end-to-end logistics solutions tailored to mining, construction and farming clients.

Shikha Transport is seeking full-time Truck Drivers experienced in heavy/bulk haulage to join its Maddington operations. These roles are vital to safely and efficiently moving high-volume bulk and palletised freight across WA, supporting production schedules, port transfers and construction/agricultural supply chains.

Essential requirements
-	AQF Certificate II or III in Driving Operations, or equivalent heavy vehicle qualification.
-	Minimum one year full-time experience in bulk haulage, multi-combination or heavy vehicle operations.
-	Valid MC (Multi Combination) driver licence (or applicable heavy vehicle licence for combination vehicles) with a clean driving history.
-	Demonstrated ability to safely operate quad / super-quad trailers and manage high-payload loads.
-	Familiarity with GPS, electronic logbook systems and modern fleet telematics.
-	Willingness to work flexible hours, including shift work, nights and occasional regional travel.

Key responsibilities are set out below: 

-	Safely operate heavy vehicles including quad and super-quad trailer combinations for bulk and palletised freight.
-	Perform shuttle runs, port transfers, site deliveries and bulk haulage for mining, agricultural and construction customers.
-	Load and unload cargo using appropriate equipment; secure loads in accordance with load-restraint requirements.
-	Conduct accurate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and complete vehicle defect reporting.
-	Maintain required driving and shift records (work diaries / electronic logbooks), fuel and mileage records.
-	Adhere to fatigue management rules, heavy vehicle regulations and Chain of Responsibility obligations.
-	Communicate proactively with dispatch and site personnel regarding ETAs, delays and site requirements.
-	Report vehicle faults and coordinate routine maintenance; assist with minor on-road repairs where safe and appropriate.
-	Uphold high standards of customer service and professional conduct at client sites.
-	Comply with site specific induction, safety and environmental protocols (PPE, permit to work, site inductions). 

Applications for this opportunity should be forwarded by email to: recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au 

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive, Senior Digital Activation Executive, Digital Activation Senior Executive)
 
Role Overview  
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation. 
  
Skills & Experience 
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.  
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice 
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account 
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’  
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief. 
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators. 
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.  
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics 
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel  
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook) 

Salary: $80K - $90K package

Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $115K package

This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams.

IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super
